snippet.title: Hideo Kojima Reveals Lead Cast Member for PHYSINT
snippet.description:
Game Creator and Founder of KOJIMA PRODUCTIONS, Hideo Kojima, joined the XBOX Tokyo Game Show 2026 Broadcast to share the latest updates on OD - KNOCK and reveal the lead cast member for PHYSINT.
